decision_needed.question: The Depreciation Fund shows a $1,000,000 'Allocation from General Fund' as a receipt (Schedule C), but the General Fund shows no matching transfer or disbursement (its transfers out are only 304,740.76 to Nutrition and Activities). Is this a real interfund transfer that the General Fund failed to record, or a double count?

notes: Modified cash basis school district (Exhibit III, governmental funds incl. School Nutrition and Activities funds; no business-type funds). Receipts and disbursements are from the Total Governmental Funds column (p9, p11, p13); broad lines were split from the fund schedules: Local Receipts (p9) into property tax, penalties and interest on taxes, motor vehicle tax, carline tax, public power district sales tax, tuition, other charges, extracurricular, licenses, donations, intergovernmental and other; County Receipts into fines (2110) and ESU (2210); State Receipts into Homestead Exemption 561,968.62, Property Tax Credit 7,732,253.94, Motor Vehicle Pro-Rate 49,459.91 and remaining state aid 7,971,522.62 (sums of the fund schedules A, G, H, I, J); Non-Revenue Receipts into sale of property, insurance adjustments, other, debt_proceeds (bond issuance 6,250,000 + premium 119,299.45) and other_financing (1,000,000 Depreciation Fund allocation from General Fund). Re-check (attempt 2): property tax / penalties and interest, carline / PPD sales tax and tuition / other charges split into separate lines; statement 2212 Instruction & Curriculum Development and 2230 Instruction-Related Technology -> support services (Staff), 2540 Planning -> Business; Schedule M program lines follow the statement's grouping: 3535/3540/3551/3599 -> State Categorical Programs and 6200-6690 -> Federal Programs (they tie to the statement's Private and State Categorical Programs 251,232.38 and Federal Programs 715,885.15 lines), 3400 corporations/private -> Categorical Corporation and Private; balance sheet now from the governmental funds Statement of Modified Cash Basis Assets and Fund Balances (Exhibit III, Total column: assets p14, fund balances Committed/Assigned/Unassigned p16), whose total 27,528,576.13 equals the government-wide Statement of Net Position (p1, liabilities 0.00). Other Purchased Services & Supplies 4,491,907.66 (p11) split by fund column: QCPU Fund 4,461,612.95 (p10) as capital outlay and Special Building 30,294.71 (2620-300 Maintenance of Buildings, Sched I p25) as Building and Grounds. Debt Service (p13) split into principal 2,109,000.00 and interest/fees 448,357.97 from Schedules H, I, J. Transfers in 304,740.76 (Activities 204,740.76 + Nutrition 100,000.00) = transfers out 304,740.76 (General Fund). Identity: 20,957,999.01 + 39,935,410.30 receipts - 40,734,132.63 disbursements + 6,369,299.45 debt proceeds + 1,000,000 other financing = 27,528,576.13. Detail: General Fund receipts from Schedule A (pp17-18); General Fund spending from Schedule M (program by object, pp28-39), which supersedes the function-only Schedule B (pp19-20), so Schedule B is not recorded; the 8000 transfers are in section other financing (negative) and the Schedule M total 29,952,447.76 includes them. Mapping notes for Schedule M objects: Purchased Property Services -> repairs and maintenance, Other Property Services -> professional/contract services, Property -> equipment purchases, Other Items (dues and fees) -> dues, training and travel; Operation of Buildings 'Supplies' (748,835.11) probably holds energy costs. Other fund schedules (C, F, G, H, I, J) recorded line by line; blank-actual lines skipped. Activities Fund is recorded from Schedule F (no per-account schedule in the trimmed PDF).
